fields.title: SoccerBot
fields.short_description: Robotic soccer player with autonomous navigation and ball detection.
fields.description: Designed and built an autonomous robotic soccer player capable of real-time ball detection and navigation on the field, using computer vision for tracking and custom logic for path planning and positioning.

fields.title: CanSet
fields.short_description: Weather monitoring system with sensor data pipeline.
fields.description: Developed a weather monitoring system integrating multiple environmental sensors, with a data pipeline to collect, process, and log readings for analysis.

fields.title: Line Following Robot
fields.short_description: Autonomous mobile robot using IR sensors.
fields.description: Built an autonomous mobile robot that follows a track using IR sensors, implementing control algorithms for smooth path tracking and extensive testing for reliability.

fields.title: IoT-Based Hospital Room Monitoring System
fields.short_description: IoT architecture with a live analytics dashboard.
fields.description: Built an IoT-based system to monitor hospital room conditions in real time, including sensor architecture, data transmission, and an analytics dashboard for visualization.
